page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text, with a woodcut diagram of a armillary sphere with coloured colures in the middle, a caption below the diagram. A handwritten red annotation in the right margin is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.l: sphæræ situ ambo simul non conspiciuntur, Aut
enim perpetuo oculis obseruantur, neq; ex conspe-
ctu amouentur aut abducuntur unquam, ut qui
ele-uato polo uicini sunt. Aut non producuntur in
conspectum, sed latent perpetuo, ut oppositi.
Sed hæsit appellatio Colurorum in duobus cir-
qui & in polis mundi se mutuo contingentes, periphe-
rijs suis angulos conformant rectos sphæricos, &
Zodiacum atq; æquatorem in quatuor æquales
maior mobilis, idem ubiq; ductus per mundi seu æquato-
